description: This file declares the HeaderChecker class used for verifying header include dependencies and dependency chains in a build system, specifically for Chromium's build infrastructure. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and dependency management logic.

classes.name: HeaderChecker
classes.description: A class responsible for checking header include dependencies, dependency chains, and enforcing include rules within a build system.

classes.name: HeaderChecker::ChainLink
classes.description: Represents a link in a dependency chain, including target and whether the dependency is public.

classes.name: HeaderChecker::TargetInfo
classes.description: Stores information about a target, including whether it is public or generated.

methods.name: HeaderChecker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the header checker with build settings, targets, and check options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the header dependency check on specified targets, returning success or errors.

methods.name: RunCheckOverFiles
methods.description: Performs dependency checks over a set of files.

methods.name: DoWork
methods.description: Performs dependency analysis on a specific target and file.

methods.name: AddTargetToFileMap
methods.description: Adds target source files and public files to a file map.

methods.name: IsFileInOuputDir
methods.description: Checks if a file resides in the output directory.

methods.name: SourceFileForInclude
methods.description: Resolves an include statement to a source file.

methods.name: CheckFile
methods.description: Validates if a file in a target can be included.

methods.name: CheckInclude
methods.description: Checks if a target can include a specific file, considering dependencies.

methods.name: IsDependencyOf
methods.description: Determines if one target is a dependency of another, with dependency chain details.

methods.name: MakeUnreachableError
methods.description: Creates an error message for disallowed includes due to missing dependencies.
